name: @osdlabel/segmentation-remote
description: PoC: client adapters from @osdlabel/segmentation to segmentation services the app already runs (MONAI Label, nnInteractive, a SAM server). osdlabel ships no server. Includes an optional binary wire format with float16 embeddings and a generic server-encode / browser-decode encoder.
author: Guy Or <guydude1@gmail.com>
